description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for three different algorithms: VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT. The horizontal axis represents the evaluation of each algorithm, labeled with algorithm names ("VADER," "TextBlob," "ChatGPT") in that order, and is categorical with no defined scale. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy,” with a linear scale ranging from 0.4 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals.  Three bars are displayed, each corresponding to one of the algorithms. The VADER bar is white with a hatched pattern and extends to a value of approximately 0.66. The TextBlob bar is black with a hatched pattern, reaching a value of approximately 0.67. The ChatGPT bar is green, and reaches a value of approximately 0.93.  The bars are arranged side-by-side without grouping or stacking, and are sorted alphabetically based on the algorithm name. The VADER bar is outlined in black, visually differentiating it from the other two bars.
